title: Beware “Recovery” Scams After a Loss
summary: People who have already lost crypto are targeted a second time by “recovery experts” who promise, for an up-front fee, to trace and return the stolen funds.
blocks: People who have already lost crypto are targeted a second time by “recovery experts” who promise, for an up-front fee, to trace and return the stolen funds.
They cannot reverse blockchain transactions, and the fee — and any wallet access you give them — is simply lost again.
No one can undo a confirmed transaction. Treat unsolicited recovery offers, especially those found in the comments under scam complaints, as a follow-on scam.
